phrase.zh: 有些时候，不落笔也是一种回答。
phrase.en: Sometimes, leaving the page untouched is an answer.

visual.zh: 右侧伸入的手握着羽毛笔，笔尖抬离左下的空白纸页；王冠形阴影横过纸面，衣袖褶皱与纸面刻线衬出质感。
visual.en: A hand enters from the right holding a quill, with its tip raised clear of the blank sheet at the lower left. A crown-shaped shadow crosses the paper; sleeve folds and fine lines add texture.

background.zh:
《良相佐国》是1966年影片，在1967年第39届奥斯卡颁奖典礼上获最佳影片奖，弗雷德·金尼曼执导并制作。影片改编自罗伯特·博尔特的戏剧，围绕托马斯·莫尔面对亨利八世要求时的良知与立场展开。画面用王冠阴影下未落笔的手和空白纸页，表达压力下拒绝违背判断的选择；手、笔和纸是原创寓意，不是演员肖像、电影画面或历史文物复原。短句为原创。
第39届奥斯卡最佳影片：良相佐国。颁奖年份 1967；参评年份 1966。
background.en:
A Man for All Seasons is a 1966 film that won Best Picture at the 39th Academy Awards ceremony in 1967, directed and produced by Fred Zinnemann. Adapted from Robert Bolt’s play, it follows Thomas More’s conscience and stance under demands from Henry VIII. A hand withholding its quill above blank parchment under a crown’s shadow symbolizes refusing assent under pressure. Hand, pen and page are original metaphors, not an actor portrait, film still or historical artifact reconstruction. The phrase is original.
Academy Awards ceremony 39 (1967), Best Picture: A Man for All Seasons. Eligibility year: 1966.
